title: Road traffic counts (hourly), Mobility Office
summary: Hourly vehicle counts per road counter, described in the catalog as counters near the monitoring stations. Catalog grain is hourly with about 15 million rows, open-ended coverage from 2021-01-01, and hourly refresh (last refreshed 2026-10-12). Counts are recorded per direction before 2024-03-18 and both directions combined from that date, according to the wiki, which the catalog does not mention. Access is by warehouse SQL request to the Mobility Office; the data itself was not accessed in this profile.

schema.notes: No direction field, no sensor location or distance field, no data-quality or outage flag. Direction handling changes on 2024-03-18 per wiki counter_replacement_2024.

spatial.code_system: counter_id (road counter code); no country or coordinate field
spatial.notes: Country is not stated in the catalog; IT is taken from the use-case geography. Location of counters relative to monitoring stations is not documented.

licence.name: internal
licence.evidence: catalog classification 'internal'; no separate licence statement found in catalog or wiki

documentation_excerpts: Counters replaced 2024-03-18. Before that date, counts were recorded per direction. From 2024-03-18, counts are both directions combined. (wiki counter_replacement_2024, last_edited 2024-04-02)
Do not compare counts across the change without adjusting for it. The catalog entry for traffic.hourly_counts has no note about this. (wiki counter_replacement_2024)
Vehicles counted per hour by road counters near the monitoring stations. (catalog description)
ts_local: Hour start, local time (catalog column description)
quality_notes: Catalog vs wiki disagreement: catalog coverage starts 2021-01-01 with no break noted; wiki (2024-04-02) says counters were replaced on 2024-03-18 and counting basis changed from per-direction to both-directions combined. Counts before and after the change are not directly comparable without adjustment.
The catalog's 'near the monitoring stations' description is not backed by any sensor-location or distance field; proximity to stations is unverified.
Timestamps are in local time (ts_local). Air-quality and weather sources may use UTC; the zone and daylight-saving handling are not documented here and must be aligned before joining.
No documented sensor outage, gap or quality flag; completeness per hour per counter is unknown.
Counter-level metadata (location, direction, installation history) is not in the catalog; the counter_id-to-station mapping is not available.
Only the production window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31) is needed; it straddles the 2024-03-18 counter change, so an adjustment is required for a continuous series.
Row count (about 15 million) is approximate and undated.

provenance.claim: Catalog entry: owner Mobility Office, steward Luca Ferri, status active, classification internal, contains_pii false, grain hourly, coverage start 2021-01-01 end null, refresh hourly, last refreshed 2026-10-12, access warehouse_sql via request to Mobility Office
Columns are counter_id (string), ts_local (timestamp, hour start local time), vehicles (integer, vehicles per hour); none flagged as PII
Counters were replaced on 2024-03-18; counting changed from per-direction to both-directions combined; do not compare across the change without adjustment; catalog has no note
Catalog has no documentation of sensor-to-station distance or outages
provenance.evidence: get_catalog_entry internal.traffic.hourly_counts (no such fields); absence in wiki counter_replacement_2024
